description: This file defines a Swift enum `AgentWorkspace` with static methods and properties to manage agent workspace directories and files, including functions for handling templates, directory contents, file existence checks, and bootstrap initialization. It appears to be central to managing workspace setup and configuration for an agent-based system.

methods.name: displayPath
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly path string, replacing the home directory with '~' where applicable.

methods.name: resolveWorkspaceURL
methods.description: Resolves a string input into a workspace URL, expanding ~ and defaulting if input is empty.

methods.name: agentsURL
methods.description: Generates the URL for the AGENTS.md file within a given workspace.

methods.name: workspaceEntries
methods.description: Lists non-ignored entries within a workspace directory.

methods.name: isWorkspaceEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the workspace directory exists and is empty.

methods.name: isTemplateOnlyWorkspace
methods.description: Checks if the workspace directory contains only template files and no other content.

methods.name: bootstrapSafety
methods.description: Determines if the workspace is safe to bootstrap based on its contents.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Creates the workspace directory and essential template files if not present, returning the agents URL.

methods.name: needsBootstrap
methods.description: Checks whether the workspace requires bootstrap initialization.

methods.name: hasIdentity
methods.description: Checks if the workspace has a valid IDENTITY.md with non-empty values.

methods.name: defaultTemplate
methods.description: Provides the default content for the AGENTS.md template.

methods.name: defaultSoulTemplate
methods.description: Provides the default content for the SOUL.md template.

methods.name: defaultIdentityTemplate
methods.description: Provides the default content for the IDENTITY.md template.

methods.name: defaultUserTemplate
methods.description: Provides the default content for the USER.md template.

methods.name: defaultBootstrapTemplate
methods.description: Provides the default content for the BOOTSTRAP.md template.

methods.name: loadTemplate
methods.description: Loads a template file content, falling back to a default string if not found.

methods.name: templateURLs
methods.description: Returns available URLs for a given template name from various locations.

methods.name: devTemplateURL
methods.description: Builds a development template URL relative to the repository root.

methods.name: stripFrontMatter
methods.description: Removes front matter from a template string if present.
